note: PLACEHOLDER lineup for the 2026 Farmstand Christmas Crawl. This is not the final list of participating stands, and the date is not set. To change who is on the crawl, edit the participants array and nothing else on the site. Each entry is matched, ignoring letter case, to a stand id, a slug, or a name. The match looks at the live stands feed first (the same one /maps uses: https://farmhousegetawaysapp.netlify.app/.netlify/functions/stands) and, if that feed is down, at data/stands.json. Order here is what visitors see until they ask for a route from their location or set their own. An entry that matches nothing is skipped and named on the crawl pages. Leave date, time, start, and prizes as empty strings until they are real — the page prints "Coming soon" rather than inventing them. Set placeholder to false once this list is the real one and the sample-list note comes off the pages.
